995.t: kamar bharaat ke kee turat jamadhar liee nikaar ||
995.e: She withdrew the dagger from the waist of her brother,

995.g: ਕਿਯੋ ਪਯਾਨੌ ਮੀਤ ਪਹਿ ਉਦਰ ਕਟਾਰੀ ਮਾਰ ॥੩੫॥
995.t: kiyo payaanau meet peh udhar kaTaaree maar ||35||
995.e: And thrust it into her own abdomen and fell near’the friend.(35)

995.g: ਨਿਜੁ ਪਤਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਲੈ ਨਿਕਸੀ ॥
995.t: nij pat kai taa kau lai nikasee ||
995.e: First she had run away with the friend, then made him to sleep under the tree.
Then she was over taken by the love for her brothers and got her lover annihilated.(37)

995.g: ਵਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਪੀਰ ਪਿਯਾ ਕੇ ਬਰੀ ॥
995.t: veh tiray peer piyaa ke baree ||

995.e: The woman, then, thought of her lover and killed herself with a dagger.

995.g: ਜੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਚਰਿਤ ਚਹੈ ਸੁ ਬਨਾਵੈ ॥
995.t: jo tiray charit chahai su banaavai ||

995.e: Whatever the way a woman desires, she beguiles and, not even the gods and devils can understand her strategy.(38)
Dohira

995.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਤਹਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਨਿਜੁ ਮੀਤ ਹਨਾਇ ॥
995.t: pratham tahaa te kaadd kai pun nij meet hanai ||
995.e: First she had absconded and then got him killed,

995.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਜਮਧਰ ਉਰ ਹਨਿ ਮਰੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੋਹ ਕੇ ਭਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
995.t: pun jamadhar ur han maree bhraat moh ke bhai ||39||
995.e: And, for sake of her love for her brothers, she killed herself with a dagger.(39)

995.g: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਭਵਾਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿਯਤ ਸਦਾ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
995.t: bhoot bhavikh bhavaan mai suniyat sadhaa banai ||
995.e: This will remain prevalent in the present and the future that,

995.g: ਚਤੁਰਿ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੌ ਸਦਾ ਭੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੪੦॥
995.t: chatur charitran kau sadhaa bhev na paayo jai ||40||
995.e: The secrets of the delusions of a clever woman cannot be conceived.(40)(1)

995.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ੍ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਇਕ ਸੌ ਉਨਤੀਸਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੨੯॥੨੫੬੩॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
995.t: eit sree charitr pakhayaane tirayaa charitre ma(n)tree bhoop sa(n)baadhe ik sau unateesavo charitr samaapatam sat subham sat ||129||2563||afajoo(n)||
995.e: 129th Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed With Benediction. (129)(2561)
Chaupaee
There had been a Rani called Sumat Kumari who was adept in Vedas and Puranas.

995.g: ਹਰ ਹਰ ਸਦਾ ਬਕਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
995.t: har har sadhaa bakatr te kahai ||1||
995.e: She worshipped god Shiva and all the time meditated on his name.(1)

996.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਕਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਕਹਈ ॥
996.t: har har sadhaa bakatr te kahiee ||
996.e: Raja worshipped god Vishnu and always reflected on his appellation.

996.g: ਸਿਵ ਕੌ ਨੈਕ ਨ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਲ੍ਯਾਵੈ ॥
996.t: siv kau naik na man mai layaavai ||

996.e: He would never recollect Shiva and continuously recounted the praises of Krishna.(2)

996.g: ਤੈ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੌ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
996.t: tai siv siv kaahe kau bichaarai ||
996.e: He reprimanded Rani as well why did she think of Shiva so much.
‘My mind is convinced that he has no celestial powers.’(3)

996.g: ਤੋ ਤੁਮ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਲ੍ਯਾਊਂ ॥
996.t: to tum ko ieh maarag layaauoo(n) ||
996.e: (Her reply) ‘I will show you the miraculous power of Shiva and then you will be convinced.

996.g: ਤੈ ਸਿਵ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਚਰਿਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
996.t: tai siv ko kachh charit na jaano ||

996.e: ‘You don’t realize the Chritars of Shiva, as you are just confined to your palaces and treasure.(4)
Chhapai Chhand

996.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰ ਕੌ ਘਾਇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਯੋ ॥
996.t: pratham tirapur kau ghai rudhr tirapuraar kahaayo ||
996.e: ‘Primarily Shiva killed the Devil Tripur and was honoured as Tripukiller.

996.g: ਗੰਗ ਜਟਨ ਮੈ ਧਾਰਿ ਗੰਗਧਰ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਹਾਯੋ ॥
996.t: ga(n)g jaTan mai dhaar ga(n)gadhar naam suhaayo ||
996.e: Then, with tresses imbued in colours, he earned the admirations as god Gandharabh.

996.g: ਜਟਾ ਜੂਟ ਕੌ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਟੀ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਦ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
996.t: jaTaa jooT kau dhaar jaTee naamaa sadh sohai ||
996.e: With the tresses as such he was worthy of being called god of Jatty.

996.g: ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
996.t: khag mirag jachh bhuja(n)g asur sur nar mun mohai ||
996.e: Animals, birds, Jachh, Bhujang, the gods, the evils, men, women and sages, all became fond of him.

996.g: ਕਰੀ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਬਤੀਸ੍ਵਰ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
996.t: karee paarabatee naar paarabateesavair sabh jaanai ||
996.e: Being married to Parbati he is addressed as Parbati-spouse as well.

996.g: ਕਹਾ ਮੂੜ ਤੈ ਰਾਵ ਭੇਦ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ॥੫॥
996.t: kahaa mooR tai raav bhedh taa kau pahichaane ||5||
996.e: But, you, Oh Foolish Raja, cannot comprehend such mysteries.(5)
Dohira

996.g: ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਤੋ ਕੌ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਥਮੈ ਦੇਊ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
996.t: chamatakaar to kau turat prathamai dheuoo dhikhai ||
996.e: ‘First I will show you Shiva’s miracle,

996.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਿਖ੍ਯ ਸਿਵ ਕੋ ਕਰੌ ਯਾ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੈ ਲ੍ਯਾਇ ॥੬॥
996.t: bahur sikhay siv ko karau yaa maarag mai layai ||6||
996.e: ‘And then I will put you on his righteous path.’(6)
Chaupaee
When he was sleeping, she jumped over and swiftly turned over his bed.

996.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਆਪਨ ਤਬ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
996.t: siv siv siv aapan tab keeno ||

996.g: ਕਛੂ ਰਾਵ ਯਹ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਚੀਨੋ ॥੭॥
996.t: kachhoo raav yeh bhedh na cheeno ||7||
996.e: And continuously orated, Shiva, Shiva, Shiva but Raja could not perceive the enigma.(7)

996.g: ਕਿਨ ਧੈ ਕੈ ਮੋ ਕੌ ਪਟਕਾਯੋ ॥
996.t: kin dhai kai mo kau paTakaayo ||

996.g: ਰਾਨੀ ਮੈ ਯਹ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
996.t: raanee mai yeh kachhoo na paayo ||
996.e: (He said) ‘Some body has toppled over my bed, and, Rani, I could not discern.’
(Rani) ‘Please tell me in details and open up your mind.(8)
‘You must have spoken badly about Shiva and, now, you are facing Shiva’s wrath.
‘He has shown you his miracle by knocking you down the bed.’(9)

996.g: ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਨ ਉਠਿ ਪਰਿਯੋ ॥
996.t: taa tiray ko pain uTh pariyo ||
996.e: Learning this, the foolish Raja dreaded and fell upon the feet of the woman.

996.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਜਾਪ ਅਬ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਤ੍ਯਾਗਿਯੋ ॥
996.t: bisan jaap ab te mai tayaagiyo ||

996.g: ਸਿਵ ਜੂ ਕੇ ਪਾਇਨ ਸੌ ਲਾਗਿਯੋ ॥੧੦॥
996.t: siv joo ke pain sau laagiyo ||10||
996.e: ‘I abandon the meditation upon Vishnu and will, from now on, remain attached to the feet of Shiva.(10)
‘Shiva has shown me the marvel and has given me sanctuary under his feet.

996.g: ਅਬ ਚੇਰੋ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮੈ ਭਯੋ ॥
996.t: ab chero taa ko mai bhayo ||

996.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਜਾਪ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਤਜਿ ਦਯੋ ॥੧੧॥
996.t: bisan jaap tab te taj dhayo ||11||
996.e: ‘I have become his disciple and I forswear the deliberations of Vishnu for ever.’(11)
Dohira

996.g: ਪਲਕਾ ਪਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਨਿਯਹਿ ਸੋਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕੋ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
996.t: palakaa par te raaniyeh sot nirapat ko ddaar ||
996.e: By toppling over the bed on which Raja was sleeping,

996.g: ਸਿਖ੍ਯ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਸਿਵ ਕੋ ਕਿਯੋ ਐਸੋ ਚਰਿਤ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
996.t: sikhay turat siv ko kiyo aaiso charit sudhaar ||12||
996.e: Through this manoeuvre, Rani turned Raja into a devotee of Shiva.(12)(1)

996.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ੍ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਇਕ ਸੌ ਤੀਸਵੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੩੦॥੨੫੭੫॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
996.t: eit sree charitr pakhayaane tirayaa charitre ma(n)tree bhoop sa(n)baadhe ik sau teesavo charitr samaapatam sat subham sat ||130||2575||afajoo(n)||
996.e: 130th Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed With Benediction. (130) (2573)
Chaupaee
Up in the lofty mountains there was one Raja who belonged to Chandrabansi clan.
Bhaag Mati was his wife, and it seemed she had stolen radiance from the Moon.(1)
Dohira

996.g: ਸੁਨਾ ਧਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਡੋ ਧੁਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਫਹਰਾਇ ॥
996.t: sunaa dhaam taa ko baddo dhujaa rahee faharai ||
996.e: It is heard that he had a very big palace and a flag always remained hoisted there.

996.g: ਸਾਚ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਿਯੋ ਧੌਲਰ ਲਖ੍ਯੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
996.t: saach savairag so jaaniyo dhaualar lakhayo na jai ||2||
996.e: That splendid palace could not be overlooked and it was an epitome of heaven.(2)
Chaupaee
When the Rani saw Deb Datt, she felt as if she had come across a treasure of splendour.

996.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੇਲ ਤਾ ਸੌ ਅਤਿ ਕੀਨੋ ॥੩॥
996.t: kaam kel taa sau at keeno ||3||
996.e: She sent her maid and called him over and made love with him.(3)
When Raja Bir Dev heard that a paramour had come to his place,

996.g: ਪਲਕ ਨ ਬੀਤੀ ਤਹ ਚਲਿ ਆਯੋ ॥੪॥
996.t: palak na beetee teh chal aayo ||4||
996.e: He was enraged, he unsheathed his sword and, instantly, reached the place.(4)
When Bhaag Mati saw the Raja, she sent him (the friend) upstairs of the palace.

996.g: ਟਰਿ ਆਗੇ ਨਿਜੁ ਪਤਿ ਕੌ ਲਿਯੋ ॥
996.t: Tar aage nij pat kau liyo ||

996.e: She went forward, stopped him (the Raja) and invariably intimated with him.(5)
Dohira

996.g: ਰੂੰਈ ਸੌ ਸਾਰੋ ਸਦਨ ਏਕ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਭਰਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
996.t: roo(n)iee sau saaro sadhan ek turat bhar leen ||
996.e: She had a room completely filled with cotton.

996.g: ਆਜ ਚੋਰ ਇਕ ਮੈ ਗਹਿਯੋ ਯੌ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੌ ਕਹਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੬॥
996.t: aaj chor ik mai gahiyo yau nirap sau keh dheen ||6||
996.e: She told Raja that she had caught a thief that day.(6)
Chaupaee

997.g: ਕਹੁ ਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਗਹਿ ਲ੍ਯਾਊ ॥
997.t: kahu ta tum taa kau geh layaauoo ||

997.e: ‘If you so desire, please permit me, I will bring him in and show you.

997.g: ਜੋ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਹੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੋਊ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
997.t: jo muh kaho taeh souoo keejai ||

997.e: ‘Whatever the way you want me to treat him, I will abide by.’(7)
After telling Raja like this, she tied him and brought him out,
And showed Raja the one with whom she had made love.(8)
Rani looked at him furiously and ordered her maids,

997.g: ਧੌਲਰ ਤੇ ਯਾ ਕੌ ਤੁਮ ਡਾਰੋ ॥
997.t: dhaualar te yaa kau tum ddaaro ||

997.e: ‘Throw him down the palace and don’t wait for Raja’s order.(9)

997.g: ਵੈ ਸਖਿਆਂ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਲੈ ਗਈ ॥
997.t: vai sakhiaa(n) taa kau lai giee ||

997.e: The maids took him away. They knew about the room with cotton.

997.g: ਰੂੰਈ ਪੈ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਗਹਿ ਡਾਰਿਯੋ ॥੧੦॥
997.t: roo(n)iee pai taa kau geh ddaariyo ||10||
997.e: They eliminated Raja’s affliction and threw him in the room with cotton.(10)

997.g: ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਤਨਿਕ ਖੇਦ ਨਹਿ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
997.t: tin tan tanik khedh neh paayo ||
997.e: The Raja thought, the culprit had been finished, and his distress was thus eradicated.

997.g: ਉਠਿ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਿਜੁ ਧਾਮ ਸਿਧਾਯੋ ॥
997.t: auTh teh te nij dhaam sidhaayo ||

997.e: He got up, went away to his own palace, and the woman, through this trickery, saved the friend.(11)

997.g: ਇਹ ਜੋ ਚੋਰ ਧਾਮ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
997.t: eeh jo chor dhaam te ddaariyo ||
997.e: Then Raja ordered, ‘The thief which was thrown down the palace,
‘His deact-oody should be brought and shown to me.’(12)

997.g: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਹ੍ਯਾਂ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਗਾਈ ॥
997.t: jo nar hayaa(n) te milai bagaiee ||

997.g: ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਈ ॥
997.t: Took Took havai kai so jaiee ||
997.e: ‘Any person who is thrown from such a height, must be torn into pieces.

997.g: ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲ ਭਯੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
997.t: til til bhayo dhirasaT neh aavai ||

997.g: ਤਾ ਕੌ ਕੌਨ ਖੋਜ ਕਰ ਲ੍ਯਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥
997.t: taa kau kauan khoj kar layaavai ||13||
997.e: ‘He is not visible, who could find him?(13)

997.g: ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲ ਪਾਇ ਅੰਗ ਤਿਹ ਭਏ ॥
997.t: til til pai a(n)g teh bhe ||

997.e: ‘His bones must have been minced along with the fle9’h and that flesh must have been eaten by the eagles.

997.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
997.t: taa ko a(n)g dhirasaT neh aavai ||

997.g: ਕੌਨ ਬਿਯੋ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਲੈ ਆਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
997.t: kauan biyo taa kau lai aavai ||14||
997.e: ‘Not a single piece of his body is visible, who and where one can find him?’(l4)
Bhujang Chhand

997.g: ਦਿਯੋ ਡਾਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਐਸੇ ॥
997.t: dhiyo ddaar jaa ko mahaaraaj aaise ||

997.g: ਲਹਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਕਛੂ ਅੰਗ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
997.t: lahiyo jai taa kau kachhoo a(n)g kaise ||
997.e: Such an explanation was given to Raja that no 11mb of his was evident.

997.g: ਕਈ ਟੂਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਕੈ ਪਰਿਯੋ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥
997.t: kiee Took havai kai pariyo kahoo(n) jaiee ||

997.g: ਗਏ ਗੀਧ ਔ ਕਾਕ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਚਬਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
997.t: ge geedh aau kaak taa kau chabaiee ||15||
997.e: Being him into pieces, the eagle would have eaten them all.(15)
Chaupaee

997.g: ਯੌ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਧਰੀ ॥
997.t: yau sun mon nirapat mukh dharee ||

997.e: Hearing this Raja kept quiet and his attention was diverted to the governance.

997.g: ਵਾ ਪਸੁ ਕੌ ਯੌ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਖਾਯੋ ॥੧੬॥
997.t: vaa pas kau yau charitr dhikhaayo ||16||
997.e: Rani saved her paramour by performing such a deception.(l6)(1),

997.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ੍ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਇਕ ਸੌ ਇਕਤੀਹ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੩੧॥੨੫੯੧॥ਅਫਜੂੰ॥
997.t: eit sree charitr pakhayaane tirayaa charitre ma(n)tree bhoop sa(n)baadhe ik sau ikateeh charitr samaapatam sat subham sat ||131||2591||afajoo(n)||
997.e: 131st Parable of Auspicious Chritars Conversation of the Raja and the Minister, Completed With Benediction. (131)(2582)
Chaupaee
In a country named PIau, Raja Mangal Dev used to rule.

997.g: ਸੁਘਰਿ ਕੁਅਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
997.t: sughar kuar taa kee bar naaree ||

997.e: Sughar Kumari was his wife whose radiance made the whole world to gleam.(1)

998.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮੈਨ ਦੇਹ ਕੌ ਦਹਿਯੋ ॥
998.t: taa kee main dheh kau dhahiyo ||
998.e: On the sight of a Gharbi Rai, she felt her passions rousing.

998.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਰੂਪ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਖਿ ਅਟਕੀ ॥
998.t: amit roop taa ko lakh aTakee ||

998.g: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਘਟ ਕੀ ॥੨॥
998.t: bisar giee sabh hee sudh ghaT kee ||2||
998.e: She stopped, there and then, and last the sense of her whereabouts.(2)
Sortha

998.g: ਪਠੈ ਸਹਚਰੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਸਦਨ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
998.t: paThai sahacharee taeh leeno sadhan bulai kai ||
998.e: Sending a maid she called him over,

998.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਖਾਇ ਕਾਮ ਕੇਲ ਤਾ ਸੌ ਕਿਯੋ ॥੩॥
998.t: adhik hiradhai harakhai kaam kel taa sau kiyo ||3||
998.e: And with contentment pampered in sex plays.(3)
Dohira

998.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਆਸਨ ਕਰੇ ਚੁੰਬਨ ਕਰੇ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
998.t: bhaat bhaat aasan kare chu(n)ban kare banai ||
998.e: She adopted invariable postures and kissed him a lot.

998.g: ਚਿਮਟਿ ਚਿਮਟਿ ਤਾ ਸੌ ਰਮੈ ਛਿਨਿਕ ਨ ਛੋਰਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
998.t: chimaT chimaT taa sau ramai chhinik na chhoriyo jai ||4||
998.e: By hugging and cuddling she enjoyed love-making.(4)
Chaupaee
She fell for this friend so much that she wiped out love for Raja.

998.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਤਾਹੀ ਕੀ ਭਈ ॥
998.t: man bach kram taahee kee bhiee ||

998.g: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਤੇ ਨਿਜੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਗਈ ॥੫॥
998.t: par tiray te nij tiray havai giee ||5||
998.e: Both, in deeds and talks, she became his and, instead of a kept-woman, she turned out as his woman.(5)

998.g: ਨਿਸੁ ਦਿਨ ਰਹਤ ਧਾਮ ਤਿਹ ਪਰੀ ॥
998.t: nis dhin rahat dhaam teh paree ||

998.e: Now she began to remain in his house day and night and it appeared as if he had won her in the swayamber ceremony for the selection of a husband.

998.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਨਿਕਟ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
998.t: raajaa ke tiray nikaT na aavai ||

998.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੰਗ ਅਤਿ ਕੇਲ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
998.t: taa ke sa(n)g at kel kamaavai ||6||
998.e: The woman would not come near Raja but enjoyed lovemaking with him (the friend).(6)
By reciprocating the kisses and postures, she would take assorted positions.
She would enjoy heartfelt sex, and, through the art oflove-making, would render her affections.(7)
Some body went and disclosed to Raja, ‘A paramour comes to your house.
‘Dear Raja, the woman has forgotten you and is in love with a friend.(8)
Dohira

998.g: ਤੈਂ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਭਏ ਛੋਰੀ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਯਾਨ ॥
998.t: tai(n) ma(n)tran ke bas bhe chhoree sakal siyaan ||
998.e: ‘Implicated in your incantations, you have shed your wisdom.

998.g: ਉਤ ਰਾਨੀ ਇਕ ਜਾਰ ਸੌ ਰਮਤ ਰਹੈ ਰੁਚਿ ਮਾਨ ॥੯॥
998.t: aut raanee ik jaar sau ramat rahai ruch maan ||9||
998.e: ‘On the other side Rani is, enjoyably, involved with her paramour.’(9)
Chaupaee
After learning the facts, Raja unsheathed his sword.
Raja went to the palace of the Rani and, on all the four sides, he put the guards.(10)

998.g: ਸਖੀ ਏਕ ਲਖਿ ਭੇਦ ਸੁ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
998.t: sakhee ek lakh bhedh su paayo ||

998.e: One of the maids came to know the secret and went and told Sughar Kumari’
‘Here you are sleeping with the friend, and Raja has put the guards on all four sides.(11)

998.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਅਬੈ ਕਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
998.t: taa te jatan abai kachh keejai ||

998.e: ‘Now conceive some plan to save the life of your lover.

998.g: ਜੌ ਯਹ ਹਾਥ ਰਾਵ ਕੇ ਐਹੈ ॥
998.t: jau yeh haath raav ke aaihai ||

998.e: ‘If he is apprehended by Raja, he will, immediately, be sent to the domain of death.(12)
Dohira

998.g: ਬਹੁਤ ਦੇਗ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਗਚੇ ਰਾਨੀ ਲਏ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
998.t: bahut dheg ar dhegache raanee le ma(n)gai ||
998.e: Rani collected a number of cauldrons,

998.g: ਦੁਗਧ ਡਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਦਏ ਚੜਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
998.t: dhugadh ddaar paavak bikhai sabh hee dhe chaRai ||13||
998.e: And, filling them with milk, she put them on fire.(13)
Chaupaee

999.g: ਤਾ ਪਰ ਏਕ ਤਵਾ ਕੌ ਡਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
999.t: taa par ek tavaa kau ddaariyo ||
999.e: In another cauldron, she asked her friend to sit in and covered it with an iron plate.
She had laced it with butter and when cold, had put it on the top side.(14)
Dohira

999.g: ਤਵਾ ਸੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਪੈ ਘੇਇਯਾ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
999.t: tavaa su jar kai taas pai gheiyaa dhariyo banai ||

999.g: ਲੀਪਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਸੌ ਲਿਯੋ ਦੀਨੀ ਆਗਿ ਜਰਾਇ ॥੧੫॥
999.t: leep mritakaa sau liyo dheenee aag jarai ||15||

999.g: ਖੀਰ ਭਰੀ ਜਹ ਦੇਗ ਥੀ ਤਹੀ ਧਰੀ ਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
999.t: kheer bharee jeh dheg thee tahee dharee lai soi ||
999.e: Where other cauldrons, full of milk pudding, were lying,

999.g: ਦੁਗਧ ਫੇਨ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਿਯੈ ਜਾਰ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੬॥
999.t: dhugadh fen so jaaniyai jaar na cheenai koi ||16||
999.e: She placed it there too and, with lather (on the plate) it looked the s and the friend was not visible to any one.(16)
Chaupaee
She went forward and welcomed Raja with great honours.

999.g: ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
999.t: te tum rai dhirasaT neh ddaare ||17||
999.e: ‘Since the time you built this palace for me, my Raja, you never cam here.’(17)
Dohira

999.g: ਟਰਿ ਆਗੇ ਪਤਿ ਕੌ ਲਿਯੋ ਰਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਸੌ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
999.t: Tar aage pat kau liyo rahee charan sau laag ||
999.e: She leapt forward, fell on his feet,

999.g: ਬਹੁਤ ਦਿਨਨ ਆਏ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਧੰਨ੍ਯ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥੧੮॥
999.t: bahut dhinan aae nirapat dha(n)nay hamaare bhaag ||18||
999.e: ‘You have come after a long time, it is my good luck.’(18)
Chaupaee

999.g: ਜੋ ਚਿਤ ਚਿੰਤ ਰਾਵ ਜੂ ਆਯੋ ॥
999.t: jo chit chi(n)t raav joo aayo ||

999.e: Whatever there was in Raja’s mind, he divulged to her.

999.g: ਮੈ ਸਭ ਸਦਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੈ ਕੈ ਹੌ ॥
999.t: mai sabh sadhan dhirasaT mai kai hau ||

999.g: ਜਾਰਿ ਪਕਰਿ ਜਮ ਧਾਮ ਪਠੈ ਹੌ ॥੧੯॥
999.t: jaar pakar jam dhaam paThai hau ||19||
999.e: ‘I will search the palace myself, catch the paramour and send him to the death cell.’(19)
She took Raja to the whole palace but no thief was found.
She brought her husband there where the cauldrons were lying.(20)
